observation: Previous meals predominantly featured refined carbohydrates, eggs, dairy, and canned tuna, leaving severe micronutrient and fiber deficits. Missing nutrients include: Dietary Fiber (RDA: 25-30g/day, absent due to lack of whole grains and vegetables), Vitamin C (RDA: 75-90mg/day, critical for immunity and tissue repair, completely missing), Vitamin A/Beta-Carotene (RDA: 700-900 mcg RAE/day, vital for vision and immune health), and Folate/Potassium (RDA: 400 mcg/day Folate, 2,600-3,400 mg/day Potassium, absent due to lack of fresh leafy greens and fruits).

Dishes.dish_name: Garlic Chicken and Broccoli Brown Rice Bowl
Dishes.recipe: 1. Cook 75g of brown rice. 2. Slice 150g chicken breast and stir-fry with minced garlic in a non-stick pan. 3. Add 120g chopped broccoli florets and sliced carrots with a splash of water and 1 tbsp soy sauce. 4. Cover to steam until broccoli is tender-crisp. 5. Serve hot over brown rice.
Dishes.ingredients: Brown Rice, Chicken Breast, Broccoli, Carrots, Garlic, Soy Sauce

Dishes.dish_name: Pan-Seared Salmon with Sauteed Xiao Bai Cai
Dishes.recipe: 1. Season 125g salmon fillet with salt and pepper, sear skin-down for 4 minutes, flip and cook for 3 minutes. 2. In the same pan, flash fry 125g chopped Xiao Bai Cai with minced garlic for 2 minutes. 3. Serve alongside 75g cooked brown rice with a fresh orange for dessert.
Dishes.ingredients: Salmon Fillet, Fresh Spinach (Xiao Bai Cai), Brown Rice, Garlic, Fresh Orange

Dishes.recipe: 1. Cube 150g firm tofu and pan-sear until golden. 2. Slice 1 red bell pepper and 1 carrot. 3. Stir-fry vegetables and tofu with minced garlic and soy sauce for 4-5 minutes. 4. Serve over 75g cooked brown rice.
Dishes.ingredients: Firm Tofu, Red Bell Pepper, Carrots, Garlic, Soy Sauce, Brown Rice
